action_items: FIX (MEDIUM): remove the duplicate <CommandPaletteProvider> mount in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminHubV3.jsx (line 184). The outer provider in AppRoutes.jsx:430 already wraps every admin route; the nested provider produces two overlapping palettes and breaks backdrop-close. critical_code_review_comments: AppRoutes.jsx:423-430 wraps the admin surface in <CommandPaletteProvider>. AdminHubV3.jsx:184-399 also wraps its subtree in <CommandPaletteProvider>. Nested providers each render their own keydown listener and their own <CommandPaletteInner>; the DOM ends up with two identical overlays. Only the outer provider should remain (or only the inner one, but the outer is preferred because Meta+K should open the palette from every admin page, not only from AdminHubV3).
The event.target===event.currentTarget backdrop guard is correctly implemented and would work perfectly if the double-mount is removed.
Document-level Escape listener addition (CommandPalette.jsx) is confirmed working — Escape from a blurred input state now closes the palette.

rca_of_the_issue.backdrop_close: ROOT CAUSE — <CommandPaletteProvider> is nested. AppRoutes.jsx wraps admin routes with a Provider (which mounts its own CommandPaletteInner + adds a window keydown listener). AdminHubV3.jsx wraps its own subtree with another Provider. When Meta+K is pressed on /admin, BOTH keydown listeners fire and BOTH set open=true, so document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=admin-command-palette]').length === 2. Backdrop click closes only the topmost overlay; the second overlay remains visible. Diagnostic confirmed via page.evaluate: `count: 2`, elementFromPoint(50,300) returns one of the two palette root divs. Fix: delete the redundant provider (line 184 and matching closing tag around line 399 of AdminHubV3.jsx).
